disciplinary_grounds.description: Maintaining an apiary without registration is unlawful and subject to infraction penalties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It is unlawful for a person to maintain any apiary that is not registered pursuant to this article.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to notify the destination commissioner within 72 hours of relocating a colony into another county.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person relocating a colony of bees from a registered apiary in one county to another county, where the apiary is not registered for the current calendar year, shall notify the destination commissioner within 72 hours of the first movement or entry into the county.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Moving or transporting bees, comb, appliances, or colonies containing pests within the state.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No person shall move or transport any bees, comb, appliances, or colonies within the state that contain pests, except for abatement pursuant to this chapter or for research pursuant to Section 29074.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Importing bees, comb, or used equipment into California without a valid certificate of inspection.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: no person shall import or transport into the state any comb, bees on comb, queen bees, package bees, bee semen, or any used hive or used appliance, unless each separate load, lot, or shipment is accompanied by a valid certificate

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing or neglecting to abate a pest infestation within the time specified in the abatement notice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No person after receiving notice shall refuse or neglect to abate the infestation within the time specified in the notice or order.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Maintaining or operating a diseased colony of bees.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No person shall maintain or operate a diseased colony of bees, except pursuant to Section 29074.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Concealing or attempting to conceal that disease exists within an apiary.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No person shall conceal or attempt to conceal the fact that disease exists within an apiary.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Selling diseased bees, comb, hive, appliance, or colony.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No person shall sell any diseased bees, comb, hive, appliance, or colony.
No person shall abandon any diseased apiary.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Exposing bees to comb or honey from a diseased colony.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No person shall expose to bees any comb or honey from a diseased colony of bees, except pursuant to Section 29074.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Extracting or rendering honey, pollen, or wax from comb in a location accessible to bees.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No person shall extract or render any honey, pollen, or wax from comb except in a building or enclosure which is so constructed as to prevent access by bees.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Keeping bees in unmovable or stationary comb hives rather than movable frame hives.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: All beekeepers shall provide movable frames in the brood area of all hives which they use to contain bees

disciplinary_grounds.description: Maintaining an apiary on premises other than one's residence without required identification signage.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No person shall maintain an apiary on premises other than that of his or her residence unless the apiary is identified as follows

disciplinary_grounds.description: Locating or maintaining an apiary on private land not owned or leased without owner approval.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No person shall locate or maintain an apiary on private land not owned or leased by the person unless the person has approval from the owner of record

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making honey available to bees by means of open air feeding.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No person shall make honey available to bees by means of open air feeding.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Interfering with the entry of an inspector in the official course of the inspector's duty.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No person shall interfere with the entry of an inspector in the official course of the inspector's duty.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using an unregistered serial number brand on apiary equipment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It is unlawful for any person to have in his or her possession any apiary equipment which is branded with any serial number brand other than his or her own unless he or she has a bill of sale

disciplinary_grounds.description: Altering, defacing, removing, or obliterating the brand on any apiary equipment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Alter, deface, remove, or obliterate the brand on any apiary equipment to prevent the identification of the equipment.

registration_required.quote: It is unlawful for a person to maintain any apiary that is not registered pursuant to this article.

apiary_identification_required.quote: No person shall maintain an apiary on premises other than that of his or her residence unless the apiary is identified as follows: By a sign that is prominently displayed on the entrance side of the apiary or stenciled on the hive, that states in dark letters not less than one inch in height on a background of contrasting color, the name of the owner or person responsible for the apiary, his or her address and telephone number

colony_count_reporting_required.quote: Every person that is the owner, broker, or is in possession of an apiary that is located within the state, on the first day of January of each year, shall register the number of colonies in each apiary that is owned or possessed by the person and the location of each apiary.

apiary_location_reporting_required.quote: shall register the number of colonies in each apiary that is owned or possessed by the person and the location of each apiary.

movable_frame_hive_required.quote: All beekeepers shall provide movable frames in the brood area of all hives which they use to contain bees, and shall make provisions so the bees in the hives shall construct combs in the frames in such a way that the combs may be removed from the hives for inspection without damaging other combs in the hives.

neglected_abandoned_hive_nuisance_declar.quote: Any hive or comparable apparatus that is not occupied by a live bee colony, and that is accessible to bees, is a public nuisance. The hive or apparatus shall be subject to abatement in the manner provided for in Article 14 (commencing with Section 29200).

honey_extraction_bee_exclusion_required.quote: No person shall extract or render any honey, pollen, or wax from comb except in a building or enclosure which is so constructed as to prevent access by bees.

import_permit_required.quote: no person shall import or transport into the state any comb, bees on comb, queen bees, package bees, bee semen, or any used hive or used appliance, unless each separate load, lot, or shipment is accompanied by a valid certificate

import_certificate_of_inspection_require.quote: no person shall import or transport into the state any comb, bees on comb, queen bees, package bees, bee semen, or any used hive or used appliance, unless each separate load, lot, or shipment is accompanied by a valid certificate prescribed by this article

africanized_bee_regulated.quote: The secretary, in consultation with the board, may approve programs statewide to train, on a voluntary basis, beekeepers, inspectors, or commissioners in contemporary and geographically relevant colony management, including, but not limited to, the maintenance of colonies free from Africanized honey bees.

value: other infectious diseases, parasites, pests, or hereditary diseases declared by the secretary
regulated_diseases.quote: "Pest" includes American foulbrood or any other infectious disease, parasite, pest, or hereditary disease that affects bees that the secretary declares by regulations

disease_reporting_required.quote: Every infested apiary is a public nuisance. The owner, broker, or person in charge or possession of any apiary, upon finding an infestation to be present, or upon receiving notice an infestation exists in the apiary, shall abate the infestation without undue delay

quarantine_authority.quote: The secretary may adopt by regulation and establish, maintain, and enforce a quarantine at the boundaries of, or within, the state, to protect the bee industry against the introduction or spread of any bee pest.

inspector_disinfection_required_after_in.quote: An inspector shall use appropriate sanitation protocols developed in conjunction with beekeeping industry, and included in the annual training.

right_of_entry_scope.quote: the secretary, or the commissioner, or any inspector acting under their direction, may enter if they determine it to be necessary, any location where an apiary is maintained, and make an inspection of the apiary, including ancillary buildings. The right of inspection shall occur at reasonable times, and shall not include any dwelling.

transfer_permit_required_for_diseased_eq.quote: No person shall remove, salvage, or attempt to salvage, any bees, comb, honey, royal jelly, pollen, beeswax, or frames from any diseased colony, including American foulbrood disease, except pursuant to this article or Section 29074.

pollination_service_colony_strength_cert.quote: The director may establish a system for certifying colony strength for bees used in the pollination of agricultural crops.

voluntary_beekeeper_education_program.quote: The secretary, in consultation with the board, may approve programs statewide to train, on a voluntary basis, beekeepers, inspectors, or commissioners in contemporary and geographically relevant colony management

inspection_fee_charged.quote: If the inspector finds American foulbrood disease has infected more than two hives of 99 colonies or less, or 2 percent or more of colonies of 100 or more, the inspector shall make a complete inspection of all the hives in the apiary and the owner of the hives in the apiary shall pay the cost of the complete inspection.
